build_flash_gpt2_model: build a flash attention GPT-2 model with tensor parallelism for distributed text generation inference
create_gpt2_attention_layer: create a FlashGPT2Attention layer that uses paged attention for decode and flash attention for prefill phases
load_gpt2_qkv_weights: load and shard GPT-2 query key value weights across tensor parallel ranks with GPTQ quantization support
create_gpt2_mlp: create a GPT-2 MLP layer with configurable activation functions including gelu variants and tensor parallel projections
run_gpt2_causal_lm: run a FlashGPT2ForCausalLM model to generate logits and speculative logits from input token IDs with KV cache
